correctness.rationale: In the valuation filtration each occupied order contributes one dimension. Orders 5 and 7 are absent, so the next coefficients of the two monic lifts are independent of the lifts. Modulo t^14 their only collision is u^3-v^2=(3α-2β)t^13. If it is nonzero the seven surviving monomials are independent; otherwise v²=u³ and the independent order-13 socle vector is needed. Order 11 is an additional independent annihilator in E8. The presentations and embedding dimensions follow, and choosing α=β=1 or α=β=0 realizes both types in every characteristic. In the thin algebra the independent coefficients of u² and z=u³=v² force the u and v coordinates of any square-zero element to vanish, whereas v becomes square-zero in the radical grading. The projected dimensions differ by one with or without the extra socle vector. This rules out standard-graded monomial quotients over every field. For the scheme claim there is an omitted step worth making explicit: over any test ring A, the constants of generator images generate a finitely generated nilpotent ideal J. Reduce modulo J² and write U,V,W for the augmentation-free image parts. In B_M the degree-two relations from u²v=uv²=0 give sU²+2rUV=0 and rV²+2sUV=0 with r,s the constants in J/J². The three displayed degree-two products of the reduced images form a basis since the reduced automorphism acts invertibly on the first layer and its symmetric square. Thus r=s=0 in J/J². In B_T, uw=vw=0 in degree one similarly give rW+tU=0 and sW+tV=0; independence on the first layer gives r=s=t=0 there. In both cases J=J² and nilpotence gives J=0. After this augmentation step, preservation of the rank-one third layer gives a a unit, u²v=0 kills v's u-coordinate, and in B_T the socle and v²=u³ give exactly the stated w-image and e²=a³. The inverse s=e/a needs no extraction of roots. This proves the normal forms, smoothness and point counts on the full functors, not just on field-valued points.
residual_risks: The frozen write-up compresses the nonreduced-base augmentation step; field-point enumeration does not test it. The argument above checks it directly.

value.rationale: These are the natural first non-thin strata, not arbitrary low-dimensional examples. Turning their valuation condition into a complete intrinsic classification shows concretely that minimal generators in a valuation set do not detect abstract monomiality, even when the valuation set is unchanged. Smooth automorphism schemes in every characteristic and exact dimensions characterize the internal symmetries separately from the known embedding counts.
residual_risks: The classification is restricted to E7,E8, and automorphism schemes are only asserted for the seven-dimensional types.
